name: Heat
duplicates: built inside Inspection — see inspection / health-record

notes.purpose: Ticking a gilt raises the verb sheet gated by her state.
rules: Blocked verbs are omitted, not greyed; one line accounts for them.

screens.name: Heat drawer · just record or join

notes.purpose: Heat signs versus In heat, and the one question that follows.

elements.name: Just record / Join a batch
elements.shows: Two visible options, Just record preselected
elements.rule: Shown only when nothing watches her. Record-only commits at once; the 48-hour fact is the option hint.

states.shows: No options block; the In heat option carries the derived hint

notes.purpose: The shared batch picker, filtered for heat.

elements.name: Batch list
elements.shows: Batches not done breeding, with breeding timing
elements.logic: Filter: breeding not started or running. Search is scoped to the chosen production line (scope chip).

rules: Tap a row and the sheet closes; there is no confirm anywhere.

notes.purpose: The option reads the chosen batch back; the commit was never waiting on it.
rules: Commit is never gated; the primary names both effects ("Record in heat · join batch 20").
Her join adds her to batch 20's breeding list; an unstarted batch notifies the admin.

screens.name: After · the row is the receipt

states.shows: No batch token (having one is normal); appears in the batch's breeding list
Keeps "no batch"; lapses to Quiet at 48 h unclaimed
